== Printed shorthand symbols ==
The transcription now uses the printed shorthand from the complete [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf December 2025 publisher sheet], p. 2, and the corresponding card image. The ▼ symbol means to deploy the indicated card from Reserve Deck and reshuffle. The [https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf 2023 Advanced Rulebook], pp. 99 and 101, defines this notation. The [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/d7881b28d79e33541236559133b4d9583b43812d/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual26-Light/large/kelnacca.gif older complete image] credits “@evvil.king”; the sheet and [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/21bad402e4ba0c5bc460b6114105fa52e833684d/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual26-Light/large/kelnacca.gif later complete repository image] credit “@evvil.kiing”. The gameplay wording is unchanged between those faces. Card names, IDs and images are retained.
